en: Dependent on a *saraṇa* (with-conflict) inferior state, a *na-saraṇa* (without-conflict) non-inferior state arises by way of root condition. [Under] root [condition], one; ... pe ... [under] non-disappearance [condition], one.
Dependent on a *araṇa* (without-conflict) medium state, a *na-araṇa* (with-conflict) non-medium state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a *araṇa* medium state, a *na-saraṇa* non-medium state arises by way of root condition.
Under the condition of cause (hetu), two; ... pe ... under the condition of fruition (vipāka), one; ... pe ... under the condition of non-disappearance (avigata), two.

Dependent on a sublime state that is without conflict (araṇa), there arises a state that is not secure (nasaraṇa) and not sublime, by way of the root-cause condition (hetu-paccaya). Under the condition of cause, one; ... pe ... under the condition of non-disappearance, one.
